title: No More Lava Pockets
description: Datapack to remove Lava Pockets from the Nether for all 1.21 versions.
body:
Simply removes all of those annoying 1 Block Lavapockets in the Nether. 

For people who want to create a future version of this in case I wont:
copy the original world gen jsons for each nether biome, remove the "minecraft:spring_closed" line and put it in the same folder structure the original files had.
